name: M6 release quality - install, run long sessions, recover and stay accessible
nextAction: Released as 0.2.0 (source e6b0040): complete 261/261 regression, module gates, staged and final installed verification (133/133; one final swing-vst3-live timing miss under load retained in build/distribution-verification/retained-failures and not reproduced), one-folder audit. Human/hardware acceptance pending.

requirements.name: Installer and portable package
requirements.scope: Per-user installer and portable folder built from the qualified distribution: install, launch, upgrade over an older version, uninstall entry and clean removal without touching user projects/settings.

requirements.name: Long-session stability
requirements.scope: Headless 15-minute stress (owner decision 2026-11-08 replaces the visible two-hour run): play/edit/undo/fader cycles with offline renders that must have sound; no crash, worker loss, packet loss or memory/handle growth beyond bounds; memory, handles and workers sampled every minute.

requirements.name: Crash and forced-termination recovery
requirements.scope: Forced app and worker termination during edit, playback, recording and save: autosave/recovery restores the last committed state, takes are not lost and outcomes are truthful.

requirements.name: Project migration
requirements.scope: Projects from earlier schema versions open, migrate and save without losing audible settings or links; refusals are explicit for unsupported versions.

requirements.name: Accessibility
requirements.scope: Keyboard-only navigation of the main workspace and dialogs, focus order and visible focus, accessible names/roles for controls, readable contrast and target sizes.

requirements.name: Scalable UI and windows
requirements.scope: 100-200 percent scale and 1080p-4K layouts without clipping/overlap; detached windows open in front, restore on the right monitor and survive monitor disconnect.

requirements.name: Diagnostics
requirements.scope: User-visible diagnostics export (version, device, plugin workers, recent errors) without personal paths or credentials; actionable error messages.

requirements.name: Source, notices and checksums
requirements.scope: Package ships licenses/notices for every bundled dependency and asset, exact source commit and checksums; reproducible build inputs recorded.

requirements.name: Exact module release
requirements.scope: Complete source suite, module gate, staged/final installed verification and distribution audit on exact identities before replacing the sole distribution.

externalAcceptance.name: Clean Windows machine install/upgrade/uninstall by the owner
Mixed-monitor/DPI and screen-reader use by a person

evidencePolicy: Only verified rows with passed structured receipts binding actual dependencies and exact candidate binaries satisfy module-gate. Human, hardware and clean-machine checks stay separate.

progressEvidence.note: accessibility_gui now also requires names for every slider/choice/text field (18), no button under 16 px (tempo +/- now side by side) and WCAG 4.5:1 contrast for label/button/text field/choice/menu colours; Tab/Shift+Tab note and clip browsing retained. Open: dialog focus order and visible focus indicator.
